newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa says spinoff terms undecided.
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa says spinoff terms undecided.

text.p: Packager Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said it had proposed spinning-off its wholly-owned Leading Edge Packaging Inc on the U.S. Nasdaq National Market, but added terms of the public offer had not yet been finalised.

Chung Hwa's deputy chairman Jenkin Cheung said in a statement published on Tuesday that terms of the public offer including the number and pricing of the offer would not be finalised until closer to the time of the public offer.
It gave no details on the time schedule.
Cheung said "the public offer may not proceed if the market conditions prevailing in the U.S. and/or internationally at any time immediately before the public offer are unfavourable."

Chung Hwa said it had filed a proposal for a public offer of 1.25 million Leading Edge shares, with an over-allotment option to issue an additional 187,500 shares, with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the United States.

The public offer will be made by means of a prospectus in North America and Chung Hwa will hold 60 percent of Leading Edge before exercise of the over-allotment option, and about 56.6 percent after exercising the option, it said.
